author: toketrain
body:
Annulos DTM

Hello friends! Today I bring you my first Nebula map since MCZone, Annulos!
It's a small DTM map that holds 30 players. It should be a fast moving, fast ending match.

Imgur Album

Map Download (Mediafire)


I know there aren't any MapDevs right now, I just felt like making a map today and showing you all, and feedback would sitll be appreciated. :p

replies.body:
a few maps have double monuments, makes it harder i guess. if lots of peeps dont like i will remove. also yeah its small ur right, its only for a short game and several people on each team.
like i said, i made it just for fun during a couple hours i had, and it's my first nebula map in a couple years anyways. thanks anyways for feedback :)

replies.author: gaboelmejor
replies.body: I see some potential in this map... If you put some islands on it and make the lunar crescent shapes look way more detailed than they are now, it would look awesome. Obviously when you do the looks you also have to think of how the gameplay will go, but I think this is the base of a good map :D If you don't abandon the project, you can make it a good map... keep up the good work! Also make the monuments more interesting... we need some actual buildings in the map, not just a flat surface :P
